question: Simplify: ( frac{3⁴ times 9⁻²}{27⁻¹ times 3⁻³} )^(1)/(3)
solution:
**Given:**

 ( frac{3⁴ times 9⁻²}{27⁻¹ times 3⁻³} )⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾ 

**Formula used:**

(am)ⁿ = am × ⁿ

am × aⁿ = am ⁺ ⁿ

am / aⁿ = am ⁻ ⁿ

**Calculations:**

⇒ ((3⁴ × (3²)⁻²) / ((3³)⁻¹ × 3⁻³))¹/³

⇒ ( (3⁴ × 3⁻⁴) / (3⁻³ × 3⁻³) )¹/³

⇒ ( 3⁴ ⁻ ⁴ / 3⁻³ ⁻ ³ )¹/³

⇒ ( 3⁰ / 3⁻⁶ )¹/³

⇒ ( 3⁰ ⁻ ⁽⁻⁶⁾ )¹/³

⇒ ( 3⁶ )¹/³

⇒ 3² = 9

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
